note: Jasper County, IA publishes zoning only as a Schneider Beacon viewer map (no public ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning layer found) and as PDF district maps (Zoning Ordinance #04F, Article 4 Districts and Maps). The GIS page says raw GIS data is available only by request from the Auditor. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for Jasper County zoning found only parcels, boundaries and conservation layers. Newton, Colfax and Prairie City zoning maps were also PDF or viewer-only on their sites (newtongov.org pages not reachable).
